## Tidy up ct_eq loop

Small cleanup of the byte-slice equality helper:

- switch the index loop to an iterator `zip`, which reads better and drops the manual bounds indexing;
- stop accumulating once we already know the inputs differ, so equal inputs still scan the whole slice but we don't keep folding bytes after a definite mismatch;
- add a short comment explaining the accumulator.

No behavioural change: the function returns `true` iff the slices are equal. All existing tests pass.

    cargo test ct_eq
